newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl to visit east German flood zone.
newsitem.headline: Kohl to visit east German flood zone.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl will take a day out of his summer holiday in Austria on Tuesday to visit flood-hit eastern Germany, his office said on Monday.
Kohl, who last week promised government aid to flood victims during a whistle-stop tour of the area, is due to stop off in several affected villages along the swollen Oder river.
He is due to arrive in the flood-threatened town of Bad Freienwalde at 11 a.m. (0900 GMT) and will meet soldiers and volunteers fighting to reinforce dikes holding back the river.

Some of the worst floods this century in central Europe, which have claimed over 100 lives in Poland and the Czech Republic this month, reached eastern Germany last week as the Oder burst through dikes in three places.
